answer_1.quote: We propose the Video to Commonsense (V2C) framework to generate visually grounded commonsense descriptions about the underlying event in the video, enriching the factual description provided by a caption.
answer_1.outputs: captions and commonsense descriptions (intentions, effects, attributes)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method using BLEU (n=1-4), Meteor, Rouge, and perplexity score of the generation on its corpus.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations using AMT workers, who are asked to identity whether the generated commonsense justifiably completes the events (V2C-completion).
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to provide this rating on the basis of whether the generated text is relevant to the video, i.e whether the caption/commonsense can plausibly complete the given event.
